name: openmotion
description: Plan, create, recreate and edit motion videos with OpenMotion workflows. Production requires a separately installed and connected OpenMotion runtime.

interface.longDescription: Plan original motion videos, recreate motion-graphics references, adapt editable templates, edit existing projects and produce reusable templates. Includes five creative workflows and a supporting media-generation skill. Project editing, preview and export require a separately installed OpenMotion runtime connected through local MCP; this package contains skills and references, not the application or an MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Recreate this motion-graphics reference as an editable OpenMotion project.
Create a 15-second launch video with bold type and the text "Turn ideas into motion."
Update the text and music in my existing OpenMotion project.
